logline: 부유하게 자란 소녀가 하루아침에 하녀가 되어 다락방으로 쫓겨난다.
destination: 런던 기숙학교의 차가운 다락방 — 모든 것을 잃은 자리
protagonist: 검은 곱슬머리에 초록 눈, 단정한 원피스를 입은 열한 살 소녀
anchor: an eleven-year-old girl with dark curly hair and green eyes, neat wool dress
palette: coal-smoke grey, candle amber, deep green, cold blue shadow

sara_girl.label: 소녀(부유할 때)
sara_girl.desc: an eleven-year-old English girl, dark curly hair, green eyes, deep green velvet dress with lace collar

sara_ragged.label: 소녀(하녀가 된 뒤)
sara_ragged.desc: a thin eleven-year-old English girl, tangled dark curls, patched grey servant's dress, worn apron

headmistress.label: 교장
headmistress.desc: a gaunt Englishwoman in her fifties, hair scraped into a tight bun, stiff black bombazine dress, thin mouth

school_hall.label: 기숙학교 홀
school_hall.desc: a formal Victorian school hall, dark panelling, gas brackets, a wide staircase

attic_room.label: 다락방
attic_room.desc: a bare cold attic, sloping rafters, one small skylight, an iron bedstead

beats.beat: 소녀가 값진 옷차림으로 학교 홀에 들어선다.
beats.visual: a well-dressed girl entering a formal Victorian school hall, trunk carried behind her
beats.motion: she walks forward into the hall, gaslight flares on the panelling, girls turn to look

beats.visual: a girl seated on a rug telling a story to other girls gathered close, firelight
beats.motion: her hands rise as she speaks, the fire jumps, the listeners lean in

beats.beat: 교장이 편지 한 장을 손에 쥐고 굳어 선다.
beats.visual: a gaunt woman standing rigid in a school hall gripping a folded paper, girls hushed behind
beats.motion: her fist tightens on the paper, her chin lifts, the hall goes still

beats.beat: 소녀가 낡은 회색 옷으로 갈아입고 선다.
beats.visual: a thin girl in a patched grey servant's dress standing before a stern woman, hallway
beats.motion: the woman turns away from her, the girl's shoulders drop, a door swings shut

beats.beat: 소녀가 무거운 석탄 통을 계단으로 나른다.
beats.visual: a thin girl in servant's clothes hauling a coal scuttle up a narrow back staircase
beats.motion: she climbs up the stairs with the scuttle, coal dust drifts, her arm strains

beats.visual: a thin girl huddled on an iron bedstead in a bare cold attic under a small skylight
beats.motion: her breath clouds in the cold, snow slides past the skylight, the blanket edge lifts

beats.beat: 빈 다락방에 따뜻한 불과 음식이 차려져 있다.
beats.visual: a bare attic transformed with a lit fire, thick rugs and a laid supper table, no one there
beats.motion: flames climb in the grate, steam rises off the dishes, rug fringe stirs

beats.beat: 눈 내리는 다락 창에 불빛만 어린다.
beats.visual: a small attic skylight from outside at night, snow falling, warm light glowing through
beats.motion: snow drifts down across the glass, the light flickers behind it, frost creeps in

withheld: 다락방을 바꿔 놓은 사람의 정체와, 소녀가 되찾게 되는 것
